parameters.command: python3 -c "import shutil, psutil, json; total, used, free = shutil.disk_usage('/'); mem = psutil.virtual_memory(); print(json.dumps({'disk_used_percent': round((used/total)*100, 1), 'free_gb': round(free/(1024**3), 1), 'ram_used_percent': mem.percent, 'ram_free_mb': round(mem.available/(1024**2), 1)}))"
